activity-date.narrative: KEN 4 is members organisation based in Kibera, supporting women, girls and victims of violence in that excluded area of Nairobi. KEN 4 has a clear vision and is been active for several years, however the organisation has not the minimial conditions for the important work they are doing. During 2023 will KEN 4 focus on strenghtening their own capacities and strengthen organisational development. Some activities regarding advocacy and attention to violence are also included. Intervention Objective: KEN 4 project aims for a transformative shift in the SRHR landscape of Kibera, empowering young women and girls and dismantling barriers to their sexual and reproductive health and rights. Results from Oct 2025 - 2028; - Increased Knowledge and Positive Attitudes on SRHR Among Rights-Holders - Strengthened Accountability of Duty Bearers - Strengthened Feminist and Youth-Led Movements - Improved Access to Quality and Inclusive SRHR Services - Policy and Legal Progress on SRHR and Civic Rights
